subject: Interactive POC launchboard — scheduling, hands-on agenda, and recap
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@novusdata.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interactive POC launchboard — proposed hands-on session

Hi Elena —

Following our discovery call, I wanted to lock in a hands-on working session to run through: prompt review + routing decisions, a short burst load test (baseline), and runbook/playbook handoff. Suggested slots next week (US/PST):

- Tue 9 May, 10:00–12:00 (hands-on + 30m load run)
- Tue 9 May, 14:00–16:00 (if you prefer afternoon)
- Wed 10 May, 09:00–11:00 (backup)

Agenda (proposed):
- 10m: introductions & goals
- 30m: prompt set walkthrough (you + Novus team)
- 40m: routing & model variant discussion (we’ll propose routing policies)
- 40m: live short-form load run (10–15k tokens total) + monitoring review
- 15m: actions & next steps

Pre-reqs: a shared sample prompt set (just 20–30 examples), and a single staging API key — we can use a scoped key for the test. I’ve attached a brief prep doc that lists the sample format and suggested sample prompts.

Can you confirm which slot works and whether Novus wants the load run to simulate 100rps bursts or steady 20rps?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
(aditya@redwood.ai)
(Attachment: novus-prep-brief-v1.pdf)

From: Elena Park <elena@novusdata.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novus Solutions Technical Ops <ops@novussolutions.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 May 2028 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interactive POC launchboard — proposed hands-on session

Thanks, Aditya — all helpful.

Unfortunately we have a calendar conflict on Tue 9th morning. Can we move to Tue 9 May, 14:00–16:00 (the afternoon slot)? If possible, please push the start to 14:15 — we have a brief leadership check that runs slightly over.

For the load profile: we’d prefer to see a 2-minute burst at ~120rps followed by a 10-minute steady state at ~25rps. That should give us the insight we need on latency tail and cache effects.

Also, one ask from procurement — could you include a short note on expected marginal cost for the short load run (rough estimate) so our budget owner can approve the burst?

Elena
Elena Park
Sr. Product Ops — Novus Data
(elena@novusdata.com)

Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interactive POC launchboard — confirmed 14:15 start + owners

Elena —

14:15–16:00 Tue 9 May is confirmed. We’ll start at 14:15 to accommodate your check-in. Calendar invite and Google Meet to follow.

Owners:
- Redwood: Aditya (session lead, routing), Marissa (load tests & monitoring), Monica (prompt guidance + postmortem)
- Novus: Elena (product ops), Ops team (we’ll need one engineer to watch logs and network/ingress)

Quick notes on procurement ask — rough marginal compute estimate for the load plan you requested (2m @120rps + 10m @25rps): ~ $15–$30 USD depending on model variant and burst capacity. I’ll flag a narrower estimate after we pick which model family to exercise during the test.

I’ve uploaded the initial load plan and a short checklist here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-NoVusPOC (Initial file: initial-load-plan.xlsx). Please drop your sample prompts into the shared folder before EOD Mon 8 May.

Thanks — see you Tue.
Aditya

(Attachment: initial-load-plan.xlsx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@novusdata.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 17:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interactive POC launchboard — session recap & actions (9 May)

Hi all — thanks for a productive session today. Quick recap and action items.

Session summary (high level):
- Prompt review: reviewed 24 sample prompts (Novus uploaded 22; we supplemented 2). Observations: several prompts benefit from explicit system instructions to stabilize responses; we suggested canonical templates for the 6 highest-volume prompts.
- Routing: recommended primary model variant = redwood-8b-q4 (cost/latency balance), fallback = redwood-16b-amp for high-confidence reroutes.
- Load run: executed the plan you requested (2m burst @ ~118rps followed by 10m steady @ ~26rps). Key metrics (summary attached): median latency 120ms, p95 420ms during burst, p99 spikes to 1.1s on three samples (likely due to cold KV cache misses).
- Monitoring: traced a cache hit-rate drop during the burst; we’ll add a prefilling step into the runbook to reduce p99 on future bursts.

Action items (owner — ETA):
1) Novus: upload remaining 8 sample prompts and label intended "production" vs "informational" (Elena) — by EOD Thu 11 May.
2) Redwood: add prefilling step to runbook and provide updated runbook doc (Marissa) — by Fri 12 May.
3) Redwood: scoped cost estimate for a full 30-minute burst test including alternative model families (Aditya) — by Wed 10 May COB.
4) Novus: confirm whether procurement needs an internal PO or a consolidated monthly charge for POC usage (Elena, Ops) — by Thu 11 May.
5) Joint: schedule a deep load validation (60m) once items 1–3 are complete (owners to propose dates) — target week of 22 May.

Attachments: loadtest-20280509-summary.csv (contains the raw per-request timing), recording-20280509.mp4 (session recording).

Next session: we propose Tue 23 May, 10:00–11:30 PT for the deeper load validation. Please confirm availability — we can shift based on your procurement timelines.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Platform Reliability — Redwood Inference
(marissa@redwood.ai)
(Attachment: loadtest-20280509-summary.csv)
(Attachment: recording-20280509.mp4)

From: Elena Park <elena@novusdata.com>

Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interactive POC launchboard — session recap & actions (9 May)

Thanks Marissa — great session and very helpful diagnostics. We’ll:
- Upload the remaining prompts today (Elena)
- Confirm procurement route (internal PO vs consolidated monthly) by Thu 11 May (Ops)

Confirming the proposed deep validation slot of Tue 23 May, 10:00–11:30 PT is tentatively good for our team; Ops will confirm tomorrow after the procurement check.

One additional ask: can Redwood share a short note or one-pager we can pass to our procurement team that outlines the expected billing event for the POC (what they'll see on the invoice for the short load runs + any reserved capacity charges)? If you have a sample procurement checklist or a short template, that would speed approvals.

If you prefer, we can sign a short SOW for the 60m run — I can send the SOW template after Ops confirms the budget.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the cost estimate, Aditya.

Best,
Elena
